IDK why there is this narrative that IQ can't stay healthy. He has played 68+ games in every season, except for playing 64 games in 2021 (which was a 72-game season, and playing 64/72 games is the equivalent of 73 games in a full 82-game season), and then 33 games in 2025 when the Raptors were tanking. So he had one year of injuries. That is it. And even then, if the Raptors were competitive that year he probably surpasses 50/60 games (just my guess).
